hero.title: Porogaramu z'Ubwizerane
hero.subtitle: Zibaho muri WhatsApp
hero.description: Hindura abakiriya bawe ba WhatsApp baba abakunzi babiri. Nta porogaramu yo gukuramo. Nta sisitemu zikomeye. Ni amanota, ibihembo, no gusubiramo ubucuruzi.

features.title: Ibintu byose ukeneye
features.subtitle: Yubatswe kubijyanye n'ubucuruzi bazi ko abakiriya babo baba muri WhatsApp

whatsappNative.title: WhatsApp Kuri Muntu
whatsappNative.description: Abakiriya babona n'ibihumbi bavanaho amanota bakoresheje WhatsApp. Nta porogaramu yo gukuramo irakenewe.

customRewards.title: Ibihembo Byihariye
customRewards.description: Tegura katalo y'ibihombo byawe. Ubuhanga buturutse kuri disikuru kugeza ku bicuruzwa by'ubuntu.

boostRetention.title: Kongera Kwirinda
boostRetention.description: Hindura abakiriya bazinduka baba abakiriya bazunguruka hamwe n'amanota nyayo.

autoAward.title: Tanga Amanota Akoreshwa
autoAward.description: Igihe gishya igitanga n'amanota. Ibyose bikozwe muri WhatsApp.

pricing.title: Ibyiciro Byoroheje n'Imali
pricing.subtitle: Igiciro kuri {country}. Tangira ubusa. Tera imbere igihe witeguye.
